d: Wood is recruiting for a Contract Manager to join its Projects team focusing on delivering across FEED and Detail design scopes of work in Muscat, Oman. This is a secondment role to OQ in Oman. Assignment duration is one year.

q: At Wood, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. Minimum 15 years of experience in similar projects
Ability to manage multi-discipline team during FEED and EPC phases

r: The Contract Manager will be responsible
Administer project contracts during execution and post-award stages.
Manage contractual correspondence, deliverables, obligations, milestones, variations, claims, change orders, and payment-related contractual matters.

Coordinate with project teams, contractors, Procurement, Legal, Finance, Project Controls, and other stakeholders to ensure contract compliance, proper records, and timely resolution of day-to-day contractual issues.
Lead contract operation and administration for FEED/EPC contractors during post-award execution.
Manage commercial interfaces with contractors, including instructions, clarifications, and performance issues.
Evaluate and support the negotiation of variations, claims, and change orders.
Ensure contractual compliance with FEED/EPC obligations and milestones.
Support cost control and forecasting in coordination with Project Controls.
Maintain contract records, correspondence, and audit trails.
Identify and manage commercial risks and mitigation actions at project level.
Support EPC tender readiness strategy, ensuring alignment with lessons learned from FEED.
Participate in EPC ITT preparation and ensure completeness and integrity.
Designing the future. Transforming the world
Reflecting the market focus for the office this role requires extensive experience in managing multi-disciplinary teams during the FEED and EPC phases,
Meaningful and interesting projects delivered to leaders of industry across oil and gas and emerging energy sectors
Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion; we are an organisation actively committed to diversity and inclusion across our busiess with employee networks committed to giving all employees a voice

d: Saudi German Health is hiring - Senior Network Security Engineer - Jeddah
We are looking for an experienced Senior Network Security Engineer to join our team and support the security of our enterprise network, endpoints, remote access, and applications.
The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on experience across network and endpoint security, with particular expertise in Palo Alto, Cisco ISE/NAC, EDR, WAF, and ZTNA technologies.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
10 years of experience in IT Security.
Strong hands-on experience with Palo Alto firewalls and Cisco ISE .
Experience with EDR, WAF, NAC, ZTNA, and endpoint security/hardening .
Strong understanding of enterprise network security and threat detection.
Strong troubleshooting, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred certifications: CCNP Security, Microsoft Security certifications, or relevant GIAC certifications.
r: Manage and maintain Palo Alto firewalls , security policies, and access controls.
Manage Cisco ISE / Network Access Control (NAC) , including authentication, profiling, posture assessment, and 802.1X policies.
Implement and manage secure remote access through Prisma and Citrix ZTNA .
Configure and manage Web Application Firewall (WAF) solutions and security policies.
Administer Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) platforms for threat detection, malware prevention, and containment.
Monitor and investigate security alerts and coordinate remediation activities.
Implement endpoint hardening and security policies across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments.
Collaborate with SOC, Threat Intelligence, Network, and Infrastructure teams on security incidents and improvements.
Support compliance with security standards including NCA, ISO 27001, and CIS .
